_readme: Single source of truth for the MAL About Me image. Edit this, then run: python build.py   (see README.md). Keys starting with _ are comments.
_mal_username_note: Your MAL username is deliberately NOT in this file (the GitHub repo is public). On GitHub it comes from the MAL_USERNAME repo secret; in the local kit from local_settings.json.

hero._display_name_note: Leave empty to show your MAL username in capitals.

character._note: Transparent PNG. It rides over the header (sparkles and all) and is clipped where the Favorites bar starts. No effects (no shadow/glow) by request.

name_tag._note: Hides the spot where the art's hair runs into the image edge. Auto-positioned on that edge. Text = Kiryuin Satsuki.

favorites._note: In rank order. Max 5 anime and 5 manga. 1-3 manga = stats card sits beside them; 4-5 manga = full row + stats strip below. mal_id comes from the MAL URL (myanimelist.net/anime/<id>/...) or: python build.py find "title" --type manga

stats.title: STATS
stats._rules_note: MAL list status codes: 1=watching/reading, 2=completed, 3=on hold, 4=dropped, 6=plan to watch/read. Matthew's rule: anime counts = completed only; manga volumes = completed + reading; mean = completed scored anime.
stats._rows_note: value keys: mean_score, anime_completed, anime_episodes, anime_watching, anime_plan_to_watch, anime_total_entries, manga_volumes, manga_chapters, manga_titles, manga_completed, manga_reading, manga_total_entries

theme._note: Each piece is "dark" (ink background, white text: the original look) or "light" (white background, black text). Gold accents stay gold either way.
theme._stats_labels_note: Only for the white (light) stats box: "gray" or "black" labels.
